programme.title: iCarly: L'odioso ragazzo di Sam
programme.desc: Quando la nuova relazione di Sam inizia a influire negativamente sullo show, Carly e Freddie fanno di tutto per far sì che Sam e il suo nuovo fidanzato si lascino.

programme.title: iCarly: L'appostamento
programme.desc: La polizia di Seattle è sulle tracce di un venditore di DVD pirata che compare per caso in una delle trasmissioni di iCarly. Due poliziotti organizzano un appostamento nell'appartamento di Carly.

programme.title: iCarly: Scuola nuova, amici nuovi
programme.desc: Carly riceve un invito per un colloquio con la preside della Briarwood, una scuola costosa e rinomata.

programme.title: iCarly: Scherma e schermaglie
programme.desc: Nonostante Freddie si diverta a passare il tempo libero con Carly e Sam a realizzare il web-show, sente l'esigenza di stare anche con dei ragazzi e fare cose da "maschi".

programme.title: iCarly: Vinci un incontro galante
programme.desc: Gibby è segretamente innamorato di Shannon, ma sa che non riuscirà mai a conquistarla, perché a lei piace Freddie.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly va in Giappone - parte 1
programme.desc: Il web show iCarly è stato nominato agli International iWeb Awards. Carly, Sam e Freddie partono alla volta del Giappone accompagnati da Spencer e dalla madre di Freddie.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly va in Giappone - parte 2
programme.desc: Salvati da un poliziotto, Carly e i suoi amici arrivano in albergo. Qui incontrano Kyoko e Yuki, due ragazzi il cui web show è in lizza per lo stesso premio per cui è stato candidato iCarly.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly va in Giappone - parte 3
programme.desc: Spencer e la Sig.ra Benson trovano i ragazzi e li riportano a Tokyo, dove lo spettacolo degli iWeb Awards è già cominciato. Le guardie di sicurezza però non vogliono farli entrare.

programme.title: iCarly: L'ho visto prima io!
programme.desc: Freddie ha invitato un amico all'iCarly show e sia Carly che Sam si prendono una cotta per lui appena il nuovo ragazzo entra nello studio.

programme.title: iCarly: La partita infinita
programme.desc: Spencer trova in una discarica un vecchio videogioco e da quando comincia a giocarci, non riesce più a staccarsi.

programme.title: iCarly: Il debito di Sam
programme.desc: Sam ha collezionato un debito molto consistente con Carly e Freddie, che le chiedono di restituire i soldi.

programme.title: iCarly: Scherzo col botto
programme.desc: In una puntata del loro web show, Carly, Sam e Freddie fanno uno scherzo "in diretta" a Lewbert, il portiere del palazzo in cui vive Carly.

programme.title: iCarly: La ricetta segreta
programme.desc: Carly e i suoi amici vanno pazzi per la torta con la crema al cocco del signor Galini, un anziano pasticcere italiano.

programme.title: iCarly: L'albero magnetico
programme.desc: Siamo a Natale e Spencer, anziché portare in casa un abete tradizionale, ha costruito un albero natalizio con materiale di scarto.

programme.title: iCarly: Il primo bacio
programme.desc: Sam scopre che Freddie non ha mai baciato una ragazza e per vendicarsi, lo dice a tutti durante una puntata di iCarly.

programme.title: iCarly: Quiz a premi
programme.desc: Un sedicente figlio di un concessionario d'auto si presenta negli studi di iCarly per proporre ai ragazzi un gioco a premi, con in palio un'auto nuova offerta dal padre.

programme.title: iCarly: Sfida canora
programme.desc: Il concorso canoro televisivo "America Sings" è giunto all'atto finale: tra i due concorrenti Wade Collins e David Archuleta. Carly e Sam sono tifosissime di quest'ultimo.

programme.title: iCarly: Contro Fred
programme.desc: Carly e Sam adorano i filmati umoristici che un certo Fred manda in rete e li trasmettono di continuo nel loro show.

programme.title: iCarly: I tre sosia
programme.desc: Kevin Colt, figlio di Jackson Colt, un lottatore che pratica arti marziali miste, invita i ragazzi di iCarly a vedere un incontro di suo padre, promettendo loro che potranno anche intervistarlo.

programme.title: iCarly: Rivoglio il mio sito!
programme.desc: Spencer cambia carta di credito, e poiché su quella vecchia veniva automaticamente addebitato il costo di iCarly.com, i ragazzi perdono la proprietà del sito.

programme.title: iCarly: Sam al femminile
programme.desc: A Sam piace molto un ragazzo, ma si rende conto di essere troppo maschiaccio per riuscire a conquistarlo. Si fa dare allora lezioni di femminilità da Carly.

programme.title: iCarly: Il cattivo ragazzo - parte 1
programme.desc: 'Il cattivo ragazzo - parte 1' - Il professor Henning, l'insegnante di scienze della classe di Carly, ha chiesto ai ragazzi di presentare un progetto originale che testimoni il loro interesse per l'ecologia.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly e Missy di nuovo insieme
programme.sub-title: Carly e Missy di nuovo insieme
programme.desc: Carly e Missy di nuovo insieme - Missy, migliore amica di Carly che molti anni prima abitava a Seal Beach, si trasferisce a Seattle.

programme.title: iCarly: Rivoglio il mio sito!
programme.desc: Spencer cambia carta di credito, e poiché su quella vecchia veniva automaticamente addebitato il costo di iCarly.com, i ragazzi perdono la proprietà del sito.

programme.title: iCarly: Carly e Missy di nuovo insieme
programme.sub-title: Carly e Missy di nuovo insieme
programme.desc: Missy, migliore amica di Carly che molti anni prima abitava a Seal Beach, si trasferisce a Seattle.

programme.title: True Jackson: Direttore Per Un Giorno
programme.desc: Durante una visita del Direttore Ruckman alla lezione di chimica di Mr. Jamison, un esperimento fallito di Ryan manda il Direttore in ospedale.

programme.title: True Jackson: Il Nuovo Negozio
programme.desc: Mad Style apre un nuovo negozio nel centro commerciale di Midtown, e True e Lulu sono mandate sul posto da Amanda per controllare che tutto sia in ordine.

programme.title: True Jackson: Fuga Dall'ufficio
programme.desc: Max, con una scusa, trascina con sé Lulu e True al centro commerciale, convincendole a marinare il lavoro.

programme.title: True Jackson: Mistero In Perù Parte 1
programme.desc: Dal museo del Perù viene misteriosamente rubata una pietra preziosa, e True vorrebbe riuscire a ritrovarla per incassare la ricompensa di ventimila dollari!

programme.title: True Jackson: Mistero In Perù Parte 2
programme.desc: Dal museo del Perù viene misteriosamente rubata una pietra preziosa. Approfittando delle nozze tra Amanda e Brock, True parte con Lulu alla volta del Perù.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Credimi, fratello!
programme.desc: Josh e Drake decidono collaborare ad un progetto per la scuola e realizzare un video musicale. Drake vuole che partecipi anche la sua nuova ragazza che però sembra un po’ troppo interessata a Josh.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La prima cotta
programme.desc: Josh ha una cotta per una sua compagna, Kathy, ma quando deve rivolgerle la parola balbetta e dice tante assurdità. Drake decide di aiutarlo, ma Josh racconta una bugia e complica la situazione.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La nonna
programme.desc: Audrey, Walter e Megan si preparano a partire per il weekend e Drake e Josh già pregustano due giorni di libertà ma i loro sogni vengono infranti quando scoprono che la nonna verrà a stare da loro.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La chitarra
programme.desc: Drake vince dei biglietti per il concerto degli Zero Gravity. Oltre a questi e a un pass per il backstage, gli viene regalata una chitarra autografata dal cantante del gruppo ma Josh combina un guaio.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La scommessa
programme.desc: Josh e Drake scommettono rispettivamente di non giocare più ai videogame e di non mangiare più schifezze. Chi perde dovrà tingersi i capelli di rosa. Anche mamma e papà scommettono su chi vincerà.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Lavorare al cinema
programme.desc: Josh viene assunto a lavorare al cinema premiere che adora, ma ben presto si trova in competizione con il fratello Drake. Il giovane non ha però la sua stessa voglia e lo stesso entusiasmo.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Lo squalo del biliardo
programme.desc: Drake si scopre che il fratello ha un vero e proprio talento naturale nel biliardo. Grazie a un’idea di Megan, Drake decide di sfruttare le capacità di Josh per ricavarne un profitto.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Football
programme.desc: Josh desidera diventare un tipo giusto come il fratello e pensa che darsi alla magia sia la soluzione. Drake gli spiega che non va bene e lo spinge a entrare nella squadra di football.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Ragazza intelligente
programme.desc: Drake ha un colpo di fulmine per Michelle ma Josh lo mette in guardia dicendogli che difficilmente cederà alle sue lusinghe. Drake però riesce ad ottenere un appuntamento.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Piccola diva
programme.desc: Al cinema dove lavora Josh si sta per tenere la premiere di un film di Hollywood che ha per protagonista Ashley Blake. Il ragazzo la adora e si offre di aiutare nell’organizzazione.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: I blues brothers
programme.desc: Drake deve partecipare alla gara di talento della scuola con il suo gruppo. Josh intanto va in televisione insieme al padre per presentare le previsioni del tempo. Ma Megan, gelosa, lo fa innervosire.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La patente
programme.desc: Drake e Josh devono affrontare l’esame di guida e si stanno preparando, grazie anche all’aiuto del padre. Ma mentre Josh supera l’esame, Drake viene bocciato.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La perfida insegnante
programme.desc: Drake vorrebbe lasciare Kelly, la ragazza con cui sta uscendo, ma scopre che è la figlia della sua professoressa d’inglese che è pronta a vendicarsi con il ragazzo se lui farà soffrire la sua bambina.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La fan numero uno
programme.desc: Un’amichetta di Megan che si considera la fan numero uno di Drake. Ma dopo avergli chiesto l’autografo, la ragazzina comincia a tempestare di attenzioni il giovane che finisce per perdere la pazienza.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La griglia di Gary
programme.desc: Drake e Josh vengono ingaggiati da due individui per vendere griglie dotate di lettore mp3 incorporato. I due ragazzi si rivelano abili venditori ma vengono interrotti dalla polizia che li arresta.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Drew & Jerry
programme.desc: Drake dice al fratello che vorrebbe avere più tempo da trascorre da solo e Josh lo accontenta trovandosi un nuovo amico: Drew. Che, guarda a caso, è praticamente una copia di Drake.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Presunto colpevole
programme.desc: All'insegnante di inglese, la signora Hayfer, fanno ritrovare l’auto parcheggiata in mezzo all'aula. La colpa ricade subito sul povero Drake anche perché nel bagagliaio viene trovata la sua giacca.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La locanda di Drake & Josh
programme.desc: Drake vorrebbe lasciare Kelly, la ragazza con cui sta uscendo, ma scopre che è la figlia della sua professoressa d’inglese che è pronta a vendicarsi con il ragazzo se lui farà soffrire la sua bambina.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il peperone peruviano
programme.desc: Josh e Drake partecipano al concorso per la salsa più buona. Megan però viene esclusa dalla squadra e decide di vendicarsi partecipando alla gara e sabotando la loro ricetta.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Marito e moglie
programme.desc: L’amica di penna di Josh, Yooka, arriva in america per conoscerlo. E’ una bella ragazza e Drake cerca subito di attirare la sua attenzione e addirittura si ritrova sposato con lei.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Mindy è tornata
programme.desc: Josh si prepara per l’esposizione di scienze. questa volta Mindy non partecipa alla gara, quindi il ragazzo è sicuro di vincere. Sul più bello però Mindy decide di presentarsi.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Relazione Clandestina
programme.desc: Drake sente il padre che parla sottovoce al telefono con una donna e si convince che sia la sua amante. Josh all’inizio non gli crede ma poi insieme al fratello decide di ostacolare questa relazione.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Tastare il terreno
programme.desc: Drake esce con Tori ma decide di lasciarla proprio quando sente la ragazza che lo definisce il suo fidanzato. Josh invece si fa crescere i baffi pensando che così gli altri lo rispettino di più.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: L'intervento di Helen
programme.desc: Josh viene promosso assistente manager del cinema. Il ragazzo cerca di fare il possibile per dimostrare di essere all’altezza dell’incarico ma naturalmente Drake gli mette i bastoni tra le ruote.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il dottor Drake
programme.desc: Josh viene colpito da una patata sparata da Drake. Cerca di nascondere il suo infortunio ma alla fine deve essere ricoverato. Drake invece, si finge medico e si caccia nei guai.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: La mano di gomma
programme.desc: Josh racconta di quando a otto anni, allo stadio un bambino l’ha picchiato e gli ha rubato la sua mano in gommapiuma. Quel bambino era Drake e i due cominciano a litigare sulla versione della storia.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Girl power
programme.desc: Mindy invita Josh a cena per fargli conoscere i suoi genitori, ma le cose non vanno bene. Josh organizza un’altra cena a casa sua per cercare di impressionare i genitori di Mindy e rimediare.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il mistero della pecora
programme.desc: Josh e Drake sentono dei rumori che provengono dal garage. Vanno a controllare e trovano una pecora. Arriva Megan che racconta di averla comprata in rete e chiede ai ragazzi di tenerla nascosta.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Il nuovo insegnante di Megan
programme.desc: Josh viene ammesso in un’associazione che permette agli studenti delle superiori di insegnare ai bambini più piccoli. Il ragazzo capita nella classe di Megan e viene subito preso in antipatia...

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Un Fratellino
programme.desc: Drake si presenta come sempre in ritardo alla lezione della signora Hayfer che già lo detesta. La professoressa decide di punirlo.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: Green, But Not Jolly / Past Perfect Love/ Instant Family
programme.desc: A man falls in love with a beautiful woman who believes the couple was married in a past life 100 years earlier. The crew's amusement at Julie's new hairstyle creates pandemonium.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: Isaac Gets Physical / She Brought Her Mother Along/ Cold Feet
programme.desc: A female doctor's temperature rises when she meets Isaac, who tries to avoid his physical exam so he can hide a congenital condition. Meanwhile, a young woman and her mother learn devastating truths about each other when they meet the daughter's fiance.

programme.title: The Love Boat
programme.sub-title: Burl Of My Dreams / Meet The Author/ Rhymes, Riddles And Romance
programme.desc: While the captain's daughter falls for Gopher, a book publisher flips a page in the book of love when trying to sign a burly author who happens to be accompanied by his attractive niece. Plus, an unusual couple looks for treasure.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Collective Justice
programme.desc: Philadelphia's Vidocq Society, named after an 18th Century French detective, is one of the world's most unusual crime-solving organizations.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Critical Evidence
programme.desc: To the astute detective and forensic specialist, the biggest clues often hide in plain sight, and what seems trivial to some is in reality Critical Evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrives.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Camera Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Photography: Forensic photographers are among the first people at a crime scene, capturing vital clues on film. What do the cameras capture that can't be seen first-hand, and who are the men and women who analyze the camera's clues?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.desc: Quand Shredder projette de créer une armée de mutants, les tortues demandent l'aide de leur plus grand fan.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'œuf
programme.desc: Leonardo, Raphael et Donatello deviennent les esclaves d'une guêpe mutante. Leur sort dépend de leur frère Michelangelo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une évasion à haut risque
programme.desc: April reçoit un message codé. Pendant que ses frères dorment, Donatello tente de le déchiffrer. C'est Kirby O'Neil, le père d'April, qui appelle à l'aide...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 1ère partie
programme.desc: Les Krangs s'apprêtent à lancer la phase finale de l'invasion de la Terre. Ils préparent l'arrivée du Technodrome depuis la dimension X, qui se fera par le portail.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'affrontement, 2e partie
programme.desc: Leonardo a survécu à l'explosion du dernier étage du TCRI, mais n'a pu empêcher le passage du Technodrome par le portail. L'immense vaisseau en forme de sphère sème la terreur sur la ville, en tirant à vue et enlevant des humains...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutation accidentelle
programme.desc: C'est la fête chez les Tortues Ninja, mais malheureusement, ça ne va pas durer longtemps ! Les tortues ont répandu accidentellement une cargaison de tubes de mutagène au-dessus de la ville.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Qui est le chef ?
programme.desc: Les tortues parcourent la ville à la recherche des tubes de mutagène grâce au détecteur de fluides de Donnie. Karai repère leur manège et décide de leur tendre un piège...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion des écureuils-mutants
programme.desc: Tandis qu'elles parcourent la ville à la recherche de tubes de mutagène, les tortues tombent sur un sans-abri au comportement étrange. Il est aux prises avec un écureuil très agressif, qui finit par se faufiler dans son estomac...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutagène-man se déchaîne
programme.desc: Pendant que ses frères regardent un dessin animé débile sur une vieille cassette vidéo, Donatello se confie à Timothy, transformé en mutant et conservé dans un tube dans son labo.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'acné mutante de Mikey
programme.desc: Un beau matin, Mikey se réveille avec des boutons sur tout le corps, ou presque. Pris de panique, il va voir ses frères qui tentent de le rassurer. En retour, il avoue avoir saupoudré un dérivé de mutagène sur sa peau pour devenir plus cool...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une cible nommée April O'Neil
programme.desc: Shredder a eu vent du comportement de Karaï durant son absence et lui ordonne de ne plus s'allier aux Krangs. Mais ces derniers ont fabriqué le successeur des Foot-bots, et Karaï veut absolument se le procurer afin d'éliminer April...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Slash la tortue
programme.desc: Raphael s'agace. Il n'en peut plus d'avoir des frères qui passent leur temps à plaisanter et à jouer, ou à faire des gaffes. Cette fois, l'une des expériences de Donnie tourne mal, et Spike manque d'y laisser sa carapace...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La conspiration des Krangs
programme.desc: Pendant leur entraînement quotidien, les tortues et April se sentent observées. Elles poursuivent l'espion jusqu'à sa cachette, afin de le démasquer. Il s'agit d'un dénommé Kurtzman, journaliste de son métier, qui enquête sur la conspiration des Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones
programme.sub-title: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones
programme.desc: Après s'être disputé avec ses frères, Raphael va prendre l'air pour évacuer sa colère.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Fungus Monstruosus
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja découvrent d'étranges champignons dans les égoûts de New York. Ce sont des champignons mutants, qui ont avalé du mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête d'acier Version 2.0
programme.desc: Donatello pense avoir réparé et amélioré Tête d'Acier, mais le robot continue d'avoir des bugs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Des rats et des hommes
programme.desc: Le Roi des Rats a créé un sérum de croissance au mutagène qu'il a injecté à ses rats. Ceux-ci enlèvent des humains, destinés à devenir une armée d'hommes-rats. Casey et Irma, une amie d'April, sont kidnappés et enfermés dans des cages dans les égoûts

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 1
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 2
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.sub-title: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Shredder met sa menace à exécution et fait exploser le collier de mutagène de Baxter Stockman, toujours incapable de lui fournir une armée de mutants digne de ce nom. Stockman mute en mouche et devient Stockman la mouche.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Tritonateur
programme.desc: Raph trouve que son partenaire Casey n'est pas à la hauteur. De mystérieux justiciers éliminent les Krangs : il s'agit de Slash, l'ex-tortue Spike de Raph et du Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La colère de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Shredder confie à Tiger Claw la mission de détruire les tortues. Karai doit leur tendre un piège. Elle réussit à convaincre April qu'elle est du côté des tortues.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête de pizza
programme.desc: Changement de propriétaire chez Antonio, le roi des pizzas. Le nouveau chef est un mutant, à tête de pizza. Tous les clients qui consomment ses créations sont changés en zombies, destinés à finir roulés en calzone dans l'estomac du mutant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende du Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Steranko, un obscur marchand d'armes borgne, est à la recherche d'un objet qui viendra compléter sa collection d'armures. Il s'agit du « Kuro Kabuto », le casque de Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Plan 10
programme.desc: Les Krangs testent une nouvelle machine pour envahir la Terre, qui consiste à permuter les cerveaux. Ils pourront ainsi manœuvrer les leaders terriens et parvenir à leurs fins.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le goût de la vengeance
programme.desc: Karai est enfermée dans les prisons de Shredder. Les tortues la font évader et la ramènent au repaire. Splinter lui explique l'histoire de la guerre entre le Clan des Foot et la famille Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fantôme de Chinatown
programme.desc: Pendant qu'ils cherchent Karaï, les tortues croisent les Dragons Pourpres qui paraissent beaucoup plus forts qu'à l'accoutumée. En effet, un mystérieux esprit sorti d'une dague les a dotés de pouvoirs. L'un maîtrise la foudre ; l'autre, le tonnerre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage dans la Dimension X
programme.desc: En voulant trouver une source d'énergie pour sa Tortue Mécha, Donnie ouvre un portail vers la dimension X. Il capte alors un message de Leatherhead, qui est prisonnier des Krangs. Celui-ci l'informe que les Krangs ont perfectionné le mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 1
programme.desc: Les tortues n'ont toujours pas retrouvé Karaï. L'inquiétude atteint son paroxysme lorsque Splinter leur annonce que l'invasion des Krangs est imminente. Dans la ville, April et Irma sont poursuivies par des Footbots.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 2
programme.desc: Suite du premier épisode. Léo se bat contre les acolytes de Shredder et affronte successivement les Footbots, Tiger Claw et Fishface. Puis Shredder porte le dernier coup et fendille sa carapace. Le père d'April est « krang-formé ».

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Au fond des bois
programme.desc: Après l'invasion de New York, April, Casey et les tortues trouvent refuge dans la maison de campagne de la famille O'Neil. Trois mois ont passé et Leonardo est toujours inconscient.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La chasse au Big Foot
programme.desc: Raphael organise une partie de cache-cache dans la forêt pour que Mikey et Donnie apprivoisent leur nouvel environnement. Mais ils tombent nez-à-nez avec une créature légendaire, le Big Foot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Secrets enfouis
programme.desc: Lors d'un grand nettoyage dans la maison de campagne, April et les tortues découvrent un vaisseau Krang caché dans la cave. La mère d'April y était conservée en hibernation.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Une second chance

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: L'ouest sauvage

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Une étoile est née
programme.desc: Walker rencontre une gentille et talentueuse adolescente de 16 ans qui s’est frottée à un mauvais garçon et l'aide à croire en elle-même pour réaliser son rêve de devenir chanteuse.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Mauvais flics
programme.desc: Walker doit venir en aide aux habitants d'une petite ville frontalière sous l’emprise du shérif qui règne par la violence et le chantage.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: L'arme du crime
programme.desc: Après la mort par balle d’un flic de Dallas, le coupable impute le crime au neveu innocent de Carlos, Jesse. Walker doit prouver son innocence pour lui sauver la vie.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Un témoin très spécial
programme.desc: Walker doit arrêter le tueur à gages qui a poignardé Trent avant qu’il ne mette la main sur la fille handicapée mentale qui a été témoin de l'attaque.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Monsieur le principal
programme.desc: Après le « suicide » inattendu d’un proviseur d'un lycée qui enquêtait sur un réseau de drogue au sein de son établissement, Walker tente de découvrir la vérité sur la mort de son vieil ami et de rétablir l'ordre sur le campus envahi par les dealers.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Hors circuit (1ère partie)
programme.desc: Walker doit découvrir qui essaie de semer la zizanie dans une équipe amérindienne de course automobile en pleine préparation pour un événement majeur.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Hors circuit (2ème partie)
programme.desc: Lorsque le pilote de la voiture de l'équipe Cherokee est mis à l'écart, Walker doit prendre le volant pour éviter la disqualification de l’équipe.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Catalogue interdit

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Les eaux de la vengeance
programme.desc: Lorsque qu’Alex et Trivette sont enlevés par l'ennemi juré de Walker et mis dans un réservoir d'eau glacée, Walker vole à leur rescousse.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Frères d'armes

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La machination
programme.desc: Alors que Walker et Trivette sont sur la piste d'un criminel évadé, C.D. enquête sur la mort suspecte du fils de son ami.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Au sommet de l'échelle

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: La bonne parole
programme.desc: Walker et Trivette cherchent à arrêter un usurier qui fait dans les personnalités et exploite le fils d'un ministre.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Au nom du crime (1ère partie)
programme.desc: Walker et Alex sont piégés à bord d’un avion qui s’est écrasé sur un lac isolé et qui est sur le point de couler.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger

Through serving the Commonwealth, both sisters continue to make a positive impact.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E30 - Prince William And Prince Harry Prisoners Of Celebrity
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. programme.desc: Danny needs an assistant but fails to see that she's right under his nose; Sarah finds out that she needs her mum.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Leopard's Den expands and DuPlessis becomes a grandfather after a close-call with an angry elephant.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: Danny and Sarah let their past catch up with them, and Caroline and DuPlessis go shopping for lion-prey.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: A white lion brings mixed fortunes to the family and Rosie is asked the big question. Amy Kriel is the last person you expect in Africa.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: Caroline's sister Judith tries to help and the drought forces Danny to sell some of his animals. Will Rosie and Max get married?

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: The drought finally throws up a fire and the wedding turns into a firefight for everyone. The omens are bad.

programme.title: Wild At Heart
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes and the Trevanians have to decide what future lies ahead of them in these difficult times.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 1
programme.desc: It's a year since we left Leopard's Den and much has changed. The animal hospital has been rebuilt and is now up and running. It's a big day for all the family as Danny has been fighting for custody of Evan and today they will learn the judge's decision.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 2
programme.desc: Danny and Evan's life on the run doesn't start well when Danny falls asleep at the wheel and drives into a ditch. They have to enlist a local farmer, Johann, to winch them out.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 3
programme.desc: Danny is asked by the State Vet to help control an outbreak of rabies in the National Park. When Vanessa is concerned for the animals at Mara, Danny assures her it's a long way away and advises her to continue with business as usual.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 4
programme.desc: It's the day before Rosie's wedding. Danny is proud of his daughter and determined to feed her up now that she's eating for two. All the family are excited about the imminent return of Caroline, especially Du Plessis who can't wait to see his fiancé.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 5
programme.desc: Alice and Danny are called out by a farmer who's trapped an African Wild Dog. As they're even more endangered than cheetahs and much more vicious, Danny and Alice are amazed to see one up close.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 6
programme.desc: When Du Plessis instructs the family to be around for dinner, they are intrigued to hear he's planning a big announcement. However, he won't be drawn on details and tells them to be patient.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 7
programme.desc: Alice and Danny are delighted when the Animal Hospital is given responsibility for the rescue and conservation of animals in the region – it's a big achievement after all their hard work.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 8
programme.desc: Danny and Alice are concerned about a missing male giraffe but Du Plessis is confident he can find him. He's as good as his word but they're upset to discover Mara lions have killed the giraffe.

programme.title: Wild At Heart: Episode 9
programme.desc: The family frantically dig for Charlotte in the rubble, hoping that somehow she has survived. Rowan arrives and takes charge of the situation, directing them to be more methodical in their rescue efforts.

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Sharmeela meets Indravdhan in private and learns that the latter has no interest in talking with her. While Gayatri, on the other hand, eavesdrops on Sharmeela and Indravdhan's conversation. Indravadhan insults Sharmeela in his casual talks and walks away. Gayatri's sister-in-laws decides to tail her and find out as to who is the person that Gayatri is so fond off. Before Gayatri's sister-in-laws could reach Gayatri, Indravadhan orders one of his men to give a drink to the woman standing upstairs. The man finds Gayatri to be upstairs and gives her the drink claiming that Indravadhan asked her to have it. The drink that Gayatri consumes seems to be an alcoholic drink. What would be the result of this act? Keep watching to find out.Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal, but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani
programme.desc: Gayatri's sister-in-laws learn that Gayatri is drunk and yet they get her to drink more of the alcoholic beverage. In a drunk state, Gayatri sets off to talk with Indravadhan but she meets another man and he tells her that he isn't Indravadhan. Later, Gaytri's mother also realizes that she is drunk and tries to hide this news from her husband. Gayatri's mother secretively takes Gayatri home in the car and asks her husband and sons to reach home in the Tonga. While Gopal Seth is about to leave the Ameerkot, he learns that his Tonga has been seized by Chandravadhan. Later, when Gopal Seth reaches home in a frustrated state and learns that Gayatri is drunk. What would Gopal Seth's reaction be? Keep watching to find out.Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal, but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!
